title: Pan-Seared Polish Sausages with Crispy Potato Wedges
description: A hearty and flavorful dish that combines the richness of Polish sausages with the crunch of crispy potato wedges. This recipe is perfect for a cold evening.

ingredients.name: Polish sausages
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality sausage with a natural casing

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.notes: Choose high-starch potatoes for the crispiest results

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality extra-virgin olive oil

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt for added texture

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Bake
ingredients.notes: Preheat the oven to the correct temperature

instructions: Cut the potatoes into wedges and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the potatoes and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake the potatoes in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy.
Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Polish sausages to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until browned and crispy.
Remove the sausages from the skillet and let them rest for a few minutes.
Serve the sausages with the crispy potato wedges and enjoy!
